fixture.name: Day Chart Fixture
fixture.note: Synthetic. Paris, 21 June 1990, midday clock time. Sun in the 10th, well above the horizon: an unambiguous day chart. Anchors the sect unit test. Note clock noon in CEST is ~1.8h before solar noon, so the Sun is near but not on the MC.

meta.ephemeris: astronomy-engine (Don Cross), tropical zodiac, mean lunar node

money.whatWorks: Resources come most reliably through skills you develop over time and connections beyond your usual circle. A teacher, client, or friend may open a door, but your own knowledge helps you make the opportunity pay. You lose ground when you answer quickly to pressure around shared costs. For example, you might agree to cover a group expense before checking the full amount or when repayment is unclear. A short pause to confirm the figures can save you from carrying more than you intended.
money.sharedAndExposed: You can be direct and capable when handling money with another person. You may also move too fast when a bill, loan, or urgent request feels like a test of trust. Your exposure is greatest when you act before the terms are clear, especially if you are trying to protect someone or keep a plan moving. Support can come through friends and useful alliances, but help is not the same as a firm promise. Treat shared money as a practical agreement, even with people you trust. Some gains or unexpected expenses may arrive privately, outside your usual plans, so keep room in your budget for what you cannot schedule.
money.relationshipToResources: You value income that grows from knowledge you can put to practical use. Teaching, study, writing, or work with people at a distance can all support you. You tend to keep money steadily when you have a clear purpose for it. You are patient about building security, but may treat every pleasure as something you must earn first. A good purchase should last or teach you something.

You may think aloud while sorting out what you believe, then feel more settled once you have put your view into words. A practical check is whether a useful task lifts your mood more than an empty compliment.

A steady routine works best when it gives you both structure and room to change course. For example, after a difficult day, you may feel calmer once you have talked through the facts with someone you trust.

family.whatRootsYou: You feel more at home when the people around you are steady and generous in ordinary ways. You need room to talk things through, ask questions, and change your mind without being shamed. Shared meals, familiar faces, and plans that leave space for friends can help you settle. You are likely to relax when care is offered freely, not used to keep score. Make your home a place where people can gather, but keep time and space that belong to you.
family.whatYouCarry: You may have learned that belonging comes through people who show up, make room, and include you. Help and shared plans may have mattered more than fixed family roles. family.theInheritedEdge: You can be quick to make yourself useful so that everyone stays close. That may leave you agreeing to plans before you know what they will cost. houses.reading: You can make your way by choosing a clear task and getting on with it. Your own plans often connect to public work, so a small decision can affect what others expect from you. You may be known for explaining things plainly, even when you are still sorting out your view. Behaviour check: Notice this week when you take charge by making a plan.

Venus ties money and self-worth to learning, teaching, and ideas you trust. You tend to value quality over quick gains, and may spend on books, courses, travel, or tools that broaden your view. Your income can grow through knowledge you have taken time to build. Behaviour check: Check what you buy this week for lasting use, not just immediate appeal.

Pluto gives your questions force, while Mars helps you speak plainly when something matters. You may keep probing after others have moved on, especially around a difficult exchange or a hidden motive. That persistence can uncover useful facts, but it can also make a casual conversation feel like an interrogation. Behaviour check: Notice when you ask one more question than the moment needs.

Jupiter connects your sense of home with people who show up for you. You may build a private life around friends, shared meals, and steady mutual help, even when family history feels complicated. A dependable circle can give you room to settle and feel welcome. Behaviour check: Notice who makes an ordinary evening feel more like home.

Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune make pleasure serious, inventive, and hard to keep simple. You can work patiently at a creative skill, yet lose track of whether you are enjoying it or trying to perfect it. Your best ideas need both room to change and a regular time to take shape. Behaviour check: Make something this week without requiring it to be finished.

The North Node asks you to build steadier habits with work and care, while Saturn gives you patience for repeat effort. You may be more used to creative bursts than plain routines, but small systems help you stay well and useful. Behaviour check: Choose one daily task this week and give it a regular place.

Chiron can make you quick to notice what a partner struggles to say or manage. Jupiter brings support through friendship and generous people, so close ties often grow from a shared circle. You may offer help readily, then need to ask whether the other person wants advice or company. Behaviour check: Ask before stepping in to fix something for someone.

Mars makes you direct when money, trust, or obligations are shared. You can deal with a difficult conversation quickly, but urgency may carry you past unclear figures or promises. Your instinct to protect your independence works best when you pause long enough to check the terms. Behaviour check: Before agreeing to a shared cost, confirm the amount and deadline.

Venus makes study and travel most satisfying when they give you something solid to enjoy or use. You are drawn to ideas with grace and substance, and may keep learning from a teacher, place, or book that earns your trust. You can make careful study part of a rich life, not just a duty. Behaviour check: Notice which subject you return to for pleasure.

Mercury supports work that depends on clear words, quick learning, and useful decisions. You can make complicated information easier for other people to act on, and you often earn trust by answering directly. The risk is speaking before you have checked what the answer requires. Behaviour check: Before sending an important reply this week, check the key detail.

Jupiter brings generous allies, while the Moon makes your hopes responsive to the people around you. Friends can open doors and help you feel included, but a group's needs may quickly become your own. You do best when support goes both ways and your plans remain yours. Behaviour check: Notice whether you have made time for a friend and for yourself.

The South Node can pull you toward familiar withdrawal, while the Sun connects private concerns to the work others see. You may handle a surprise best after stepping away from the noise and having time alone. Private rest is useful when it helps you return with a clear choice. Behaviour check: Take a quiet pause this week before deciding what to do next.

overview.headline: You build a public life by turning quick thinking into work people can rely on.
overview.distinctive: You are quick with words, but you are not interested in talking for its own sake. You want the explanation to lead somewhere, such as a decision, a piece of work, or a better way to do things. You can be both flexible in thought and serious about the result. That combination helps you learn fast without treating every idea as equally useful. It can also make rest feel like a task you have not yet earned. Your drive is especially strong when shared money, trust, or responsibility is involved. You may push for an answer before everyone has agreed on the terms, then realise the promise is harder to carry than it sounded. A pause to check the figures and ask what each person can actually do helps you protect both your independence and your relationships.
overview.temperament: The Sun is the leading light here, so you feel most settled when your choices serve a clear direction and your effort can be seen. You take in information by comparing details and asking another question. You explain your thinking while you are still working it out. You investigate first and commit second. When a decision is urgent, you can state your case plainly and act without much delay. Earth is strongest in what you are made of, so you trust what can be tested, practised, and made to last. Cardinal is strongest in what you do with a course, so once you see a useful next step, you tend to start it yourself. You may begin quickly, then rely on a clear plan to keep the work moving.
overview.concentration: You keep returning to questions that can be explained, taught, or put to use. Work takes up real room in your thoughts, and you often sort out an idea by talking it through. You also give steady attention to making things, practising a skill, or improving something you enjoy. Your private life can get less attention when a useful task is waiting. You may notice only later that you need time with no one asking anything of you.

foundation.chartThesis: You build a public life through clear words and quick decisions. Recognition matters, but your best work comes when you give an idea enough structure to last.
foundation.centralTension: You can act fast when shared money or trust is at stake, then find you promised more than the situation can hold. Your drive protects your independence, while your wish to help protects your ties with others.
foundation.dominantPattern: You turn questions into work other people can use. Speaking, learning, earning, and choosing collaborators all feed a public role, while capable allies help you carry it.

discoveries.opening: You can move quickly when a shared decision feels urgent, yet you also want to be generous and keep everyone included. Your best choices come when you give both impulses time to speak.

paradoxes.title: Fast Help, Firm Limits
paradoxes.tension: When someone needs an answer about shared money, you can respond with nerve and speed. You would rather face a difficult conversation than leave it hanging. But your confidence can outrun the details, especially when you want to protect someone or keep a plan moving. Later, you may discover that the commitment costs more than you expected. You can be both the person who speaks plainly and the person who agreed before checking every number. A pause can feel unhelpful, even when it protects everyone.
paradoxes.invitation: You do not have to choose between courage and care. Ask for the figures, the deadline, and what happens if plans change before you commit. That small delay gives your directness something solid to work with. You can still help, while making promises you can keep.

paradoxes.title: Joy With a Work Ethic
paradoxes.tension: You can take pleasure seriously. A hobby, a romance, or something you make may matter enough for you to practise and improve it over time. You enjoy knowing you can do it well. The trouble starts when every good thing acquires a standard, a schedule, or a result to justify its place. You may keep refining a piece of work instead of enjoying it, or treat rest as something you must earn. You want lasting satisfaction, but can make delight feel like another responsibility.
paradoxes.invitation: Let some things stay worthwhile without becoming impressive or finished. Make time for an activity with no audience and no target. You can keep your care and skill, while allowing pleasure to arrive before you have proved anything.

paradoxes.title: Private Needs, Public Plans
paradoxes.tension: People may rely on you because you sound clear and capable when a group needs direction. You can explain the next step and bring others into a shared plan. Yet some of what shapes your life arrives when nobody is watching, and you may need quiet before you know how it has affected you. You can feel pressure to stay available because others trust your answers. Then you find yourself handling a change alone, after everyone else assumes you are fine.
paradoxes.invitation: You can be dependable without being available at every moment. Name when you need time alone, and return with a practical answer once you have had it. Your public commitments can grow stronger when you make room for the private decisions that support them.

relationships.howYouLove: You need warmth, steadiness, and a friendship that feels dependable before you let someone close. You show love by staying, making time, and taking shared plans seriously. You are drawn to people with kind hearts and practical follow-through, even if you tell yourself quick wit or big promises matter most. Shared beliefs and the chance to learn together keep your interest alive. You feel safer when affection is backed by actions you can count on.
relationships.theChallenge: You can move fast when trust, money, or dependence is involved. You may take charge to protect yourself, then realise you agreed to more than the facts could support. If a partner offers help, you can want it and resist it at once. You may also treat pleasure like a duty, waiting until everything is settled before relaxing together. The result can be a tense talk about what each person owes, after both of you thought the terms were clear.

connectBestWith.item: A Moon or Venus in an earth sign
connectBestWith.reason: They may offer the steady affection and follow-through that help you feel safe.

connectBestWith.item: A Jupiter in a water sign
connectBestWith.reason: They may meet your wish for a generous, caring friendship in partnership.
They may value patience and keep shared plans grounded.
They may talk plainly about tension and shared decisions instead of letting pressure build.

relationships.whatPartnershipAsks: You are learning to let closeness include ordinary teamwork, not only loyalty or shared ideals. Choose people who make room for disagreement and keep their promises in daily life. Say what you can offer before stepping in, especially when money or emotional support is shared. You do not have to handle every hard moment alone to stay independent. A good partnership gives both people room to help and room to say no.

venus_trine_saturn.growth: Treating the ease as a resource to be invested rather than a comfort to rest in.
venus_trine_saturn.dynamic: Venus and Saturn. Venus is attraction, pleasure, taste, and the capacity to draw people in. Saturn is structure, limit, duration, and the discipline that makes things last. Two functions in signs of the same element flow into each other without resistance. What they do together comes easily, often so easily that it goes unnoticed and undervalued.
venus_trine_saturn.tension: Complacency. The gift is taken for granted, left undeveloped, or used as an excuse to avoid harder things.
venus_trine_saturn.behavior: Effortless talent. The two functions combine naturally and reliably.

jupiter_trine_pluto.growth: Treating the ease as a resource to be invested rather than a comfort to rest in.
jupiter_trine_pluto.dynamic: Jupiter and Pluto. Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Pluto is intensity, power, and transformation through what cannot be avoided. Two functions in signs of the same element flow into each other without resistance. What they do together comes easily, often so easily that it goes unnoticed and undervalued.
jupiter_trine_pluto.tension: Complacency. The gift is taken for granted, left undeveloped, or used as an excuse to avoid harder things.
jupiter_trine_pluto.behavior: Effortless talent. The two functions combine naturally and reliably.

mars_square_jupiter.growth: Accepting that the tension is permanent and building something out of it rather than trying to resolve it.
mars_square_jupiter.dynamic: Mars and Jupiter. Mars is drive, assertion, and the capacity to cut through and go after something. Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Two functions in signs that share a mode but not an element push against each other. Neither yields easily, so the pressure is constant and productive: this is where effort is forced and skill is built.
mars_square_jupiter.tension: Recurring conflict, frustration, and the sense of being pulled two ways at once.
mars_square_jupiter.behavior: Hard-won competence. The friction has been turned into a driving engine.

mercury_sextile_mars.growth: Deliberately using the connection rather than waiting for it to act on its own.
mercury_sextile_mars.dynamic: Mercury and Mars. Mercury is how a person thinks, learns, decides and makes themselves understood. Mars is drive, assertion, and the capacity to cut through and go after something. Two functions in compatible signs support each other when asked. The connection is friendly and productive but not automatic: it is an opportunity rather than a given.
mercury_sextile_mars.tension: Underused. The help is available but not taken, so the opportunity goes quiet.
mercury_sextile_mars.behavior: The two cooperate readily and produce practical results with modest effort.

neptune_sextile_pluto.growth: Deliberately using the connection rather than waiting for it to act on its own.

Pluto is intensity, power, and transformation through what cannot be avoided. Two functions in compatible signs support each other when asked. The connection is friendly and productive but not automatic: it is an opportunity rather than a given.

neptune_sextile_pluto.behavior: The two cooperate readily and produce practical results with modest effort.

moon_conjunction_mercury.growth: Learning to feel which of the two is speaking, and to give each its turn.
moon_conjunction_mercury.dynamic: Moon and Mercury. The Moon is the body, the habits, and what makes someone feel safe. Mercury is how a person thinks, learns, decides and makes themselves understood. Two functions occupy the same place and act as one. Neither can be used without engaging the other, so their natures blend, for better or worse depending on how compatible they are.
moon_conjunction_mercury.tension: The two cannot be separated, so the difficulty of one contaminates the other and there is no clean way to use either alone.
moon_conjunction_mercury.behavior: The two work as a single combined strength, each amplifying the other.

jupiter_opposition_saturn.growth: Owning both ends instead of projecting one, and finding the position between them.
jupiter_opposition_saturn.dynamic: Jupiter and Saturn. Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Saturn is structure, limit, duration, and the discipline that makes things last. Two functions in opposite signs pull in opposite directions and can see each other clearly. The tension is external and relational: it tends to play out between the person and someone else, or as a swing between two extremes.
jupiter_opposition_saturn.tension: Polarisation. The person identifies with one side and meets the other in someone else, usually as conflict.
jupiter_opposition_saturn.behavior: Balance and perspective. Each side tempers the other and the person can hold both.

personalPlanets.sun: The Sun is the centre of identity and the sense of what one is for. Gemini is quick, curious, verbal, and interested in everything at once. The 10th is vocation, reputation, and what one is known for doing.
personalPlanets.mars: Mars is drive, assertion, and the capacity to cut through and go after something. Aries acts first, directly and fast, and sorts things out afterward. The 8th is shared resources, loss, inheritance, and what is not one's own.
personalPlanets.moon: The Moon is the body, the habits, and what makes someone feel safe. Gemini is quick, curious, verbal, and interested in everything at once. The 10th is vocation, reputation, and what one is known for doing.
personalPlanets.pluto: Pluto is intensity, power, and transformation through what cannot be avoided. Scorpio goes deep, holds on, and does not do anything by halves. The 3rd is the near world: siblings, neighbours, daily talk, and learning.
personalPlanets.venus: Venus is attraction, pleasure, taste, and the capacity to draw people in. Taurus is steady, sensual, slow to start and slower to stop. The 9th is the far world: belief, higher learning, travel, and meaning.
personalPlanets.chiron: Chiron marks a wound that becomes a source of skill and understanding for others. Pisces feels everything, blurs boundaries, and gives more than it keeps. The 7th is the other: partners, spouses, open rivals, and one-to-one bonds.
personalPlanets.saturn: Saturn is structure, limit, duration, and the discipline that makes things last. Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, and plays the long game. The 5th is pleasure, creativity, children, and what one does for its own sake.
personalPlanets.uranus: Uranus is disruption, independence, and the sudden break from what was expected. Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, and plays the long game. The 5th is pleasure, creativity, children, and what one does for its own sake.
personalPlanets.jupiter: Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Cancer protects, remembers, and holds close what it cares about. The 11th is allies, friends, groups, and hopes shared with others.
personalPlanets.mercury: Mercury is how a person thinks, learns, decides and makes themselves understood. Gemini is quick, curious, verbal, and interested in everything at once. The 10th is vocation, reputation, and what one is known for doing.
personalPlanets.neptune: Neptune is dissolution, longing, imagination, and the blurring of hard edges. Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, and plays the long game. The 5th is pleasure, creativity, children, and what one does for its own sake.
personalPlanets.north_node: The North Node is the direction of growth: unfamiliar, uncomfortable, and worth it. Aquarius stands apart, thinks in systems, and cares about the group. The 6th is work, routine, health, and what must be maintained.
personalPlanets.south_node: The South Node is the default: what comes easily and what gets overused. Leo is warm, proud, generous, and needs to be seen doing it. The 12th is what is hidden: solitude, sorrow, secrets, and self-undoing.
